name: Norwegian School of Sport Sciences
summary: Sport sciences school in Oslo; four bachelor's (outdoor life, sport management, coaching, training and health), all taught in Norwegian.

ib.text: Study in Norwegian if you have Danish, Swedish or Norwegian A (SL or HL), or Norwegian B HL, at grade 3 or better: that documents Norwegian, and you apply through Samordna opptak.

notes: NIH teaches in English only in online courses, one-year study, master's and PhD; you apply for its bachelor's through Samordna opptak.
NIH asks for Norwegian at B2 for its Norwegian-taught programmes and refers to Samordna opptak's list of ways to meet it, which includes Danish A.
NIH gives the ordinary Samordna opptak deadline as 15 April; the 2027 calendar is not yet published.
